newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka sees medium/high grown tea prices up.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka sees medium/high grown tea prices up.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state Tea Board said on Monday it expected prices of medium and high-grown liquoring teas to rise during the rest of this year.
Tea Board chairman Clifford Ratwatte told Reuters he thought prices of this quality would trend up towards the 114/115 rupees a kg level currently being achieved by low-grown tea.
"Medium/high grown tea can rise a little more. I think it will catch up with low-grown," he said in an interview.
Medium and high-grown teas were quoted at between 94 and 95 rupees per kg at last week's Colombo tea auction, up from 92 to 93 rupees a kg the previous week.
Ratwatte said he did not expect much change in low-grown tea prices.
